{
  "name": "hud",
  "version": "0.9.1",
  "description": "Heads-up display for Claude Code and Copilot CLI: token-weather band with PR, git and limit forecasts, turn footer, tool rows, spinner, /weather, /subagents and /ctx panes (Claude mod), a two-line status line for both CLIs, and reply rewrites (links, paths, commits, states, pass/fail, secrets, URLs, times) in Claude Code and pi",
  "author": {
    "name": "giocaizzi",
    "url": "https://github.com/giocaizzi"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/giocaizzi/harness",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "statusline",
    "ui",
    "mod",
    "claude-code",
    "copilot-cli"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "glyphs": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Reply: glyphs",
      "description": "Nerd Font glyphs in reply rewrites (a feature can turn its own off). NO_COLOR turns them off too.",
      "required": false,
      "default": true
    },
    "colour": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Reply: colour",
      "description": "Colour in reply rewrites (a feature can turn its own off). NO_COLOR turns it off too.",
      "required": false,
      "default": true
    },
    "replySecrets": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: mask secrets",
      "description": "GitHub, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS and Slack tokens, bearer tokens and private keys keep their prefix and lose the rest, code included. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyUrls": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: short URLs",
      "description": "Long URLs drawn as owner/repo#12, group/proj!4, repo@sha, repo › path:line or host and short path; the link stays. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyRefs": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: work-item links",
      "description": "#123, !45, owner/repo#12 and AB#77 drawn as links to the forge of upstream, else origin. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyState": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: work-item state",
      "description": "Open, merged, closed or draft glyph on a work-item reference, read from gh, glab or az and cached for the session. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyPaths": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: short paths",
      "description": "Absolute paths drawn as <repo> › path, <repo>[worktree] › path or ~/path; only paths that exist. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyFileLinks": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: file links",
      "description": "Paths and file:line[:col] made links that open the editor below; only files that exist. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyCommits": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: commit links",
      "description": "Commit SHAs of the session repository drawn as links to the forge; only real commits. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyTimes": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: times",
      "description": "ISO-8601 timestamps drawn as local time and how long ago. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "replyStatus": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: pass/fail",
      "description": "pass, ok, ✓ green; fail, error, ✗ red; skipped, pending dim, in table cells, list items and name: status lines; counts after a table or list. on: glyph and colour as set above; off; no-glyph; no-colour; plain (neither).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off",
        "no-glyph",
        "no-colour",
        "plain"
      ]
    },
    "editor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: editor",
      "description": "What a file link opens; custom uses the template below.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "vscode",
      "options": [
        "vscode",
        "cursor",
        "zed",
        "idea",
        "sublime",
        "file",
        "custom"
      ]
    },
    "editorUrl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: custom editor URL",
      "description": "For editor custom: a URL with {path} {line} {col}, e.g. nvim://open?file={path}&line={line}.",
      "required": false,
      "default": ""
    },
    "timeFormat": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply: time format",
      "description": "both: 13 Oct 20:56 (5h ago); absolute; relative.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "both",
      "options": [
        "both",
        "absolute",
        "relative"
      ]
    }
  }
}
